detail: Felix 不可被視為 Oscar 的同質 clone：它沒有完整 Xcode，開發 clone 漂移，且正式 API、Cloudflare connector、備份、reconciler 與其他常駐服務都在同一台。更重要的是 backend pytest 會執行 candidate commit 的 conftest、import-time code與 subprocess；typed profile 不是沙箱，clean commit也可能讀 secrets、碰 Docker socket或打 localhost production。因此 control plane 必須是預先安裝、host-owned、與 candidate capsule 分離且 digest-pinned 的 trusted controller；candidate code只在 OrbStack 的 pinned OCI runner中執行，採 network=none、唯讀 source/rootfs、隔離 HOME/TMP/venv、非 root uid、cap-drop=ALL、no-new-privileges、無 Docker socket／host network／production mount，並限制 pids、CPU、memory、scratch quota與 wall timeout。不相容此邊界的 profile保持 local-only。Oscar 產生 clean committed tree 的 deterministic capsule與 CSPRNG nonce/request digest；Felix 在 host-owned job root materialize並核對 commit/tree digest，candidate child看不到簽章私鑰。trusted admission controller只讀 allowlisted structured health surface，與 /tmp/kg-deploy.lock、backup/reconcile activity及 single-heavy-job lock協調；production永遠優先，child執行中週期監測紅態並 TERM→grace→KILL。Felix-local非對稱私鑰不得放 repo、candidate tree、Syncthing或通用 secrets mount；controller簽 canonical receipt，Oscar pin公鑰。job生命週期固定 staged→running→terminal→fetched→acked→gc：Oscar驗digest並原子落盤後，以request內candidate不可見的one-time 256-bit ACK MAC key對canonical job_id＋receipt_digest做HMAC；Felix trusted controller驗MAC後才標acked、zeroize key並允許刪除；斷線／crash residue由 age＋quota reaper處理，永不刪 active／locked job。stdout只回 bounded terminal JSON，stderr只回安全 phase／elapsed／bytes，禁止 raw argv、env、path、process command line與secret。
plan: 1. 先以 fake host與惡意 committed fixture寫紅測試，覆蓋錯 SHA、dirty source、special file／symlink escape、讀寫 dev/prod/data/secrets、Docker socket、localhost/network、bind port、subprocess fan-out、secret marker、資源不足、deploy lock、backup/reconcile競態、timeout、controller/worker crash與partial transfer。2. 實作 deterministic capsule manifest；只納入指定 commit的tracked tree，設大小上限，materialize前後驗commit/tree digest，source以唯讀方式提供給job。3. 建立operator-only installer/doctor：把trusted controller、pinned OCI runner digest與Felix public key identity安裝在candidate tree外；私鑰Felix-local、不同步且child不可見。4. 以版本化admission policy寫死capability、memory/load/disk/health thresholds與reason codes；production lock/activity優先，single-heavy-job lock只限制compute，執行中固定cadence監測，紅態TERM→grace→KILL process group。5. job child固定network=none、read-only rootfs/source、isolated HOME/TMP/venv、non-root、cap-drop、no-new-privileges、無host mounts/socket，並套pids/CPU/memory/disk/time hard limits；不相容profile拒絕remote。6. 以Oscar nonce/request digest建立canonical signed receipt與one-time job id；實作staged→running→terminal→fetched→acked→gc、controller-only one-time ACK MAC key、HMAC(job_id＋receipt_digest)、Felix-side ACK verification／key zeroize、atomic local persistence、quota/TTL reaper與冪等cleanup。7. 斷言remote dev/prod clone、registry、main、gate record與production roots前後不變；跑單測/docs gate，最後以operator-only跨機selftest產出different-host／xmachine-ssh／independent Oscar verifier／ack_verified／acked、live sandbox、production-before-after與signed-receipt證據，再同步safety/host topology。
